top_choice_rationale: P003 rewards a bounded, experimentally decisive achievement: magic-wavelength lattice clocks by Katori and Ye, which made 10^-18 fractional uncertainty reproducible and has been independently confirmed and surpassed at RIKEN/Tokyo, JILA, NIST, PTB and SYRTE. Two names map cleanly to two distinct contributions (proposal and first demonstration, systematics and coherence programme), the citation scope is narrow enough to separate it from the comb and ion-control prizes, and the instrument has opened new measurements (redshift, constants, dark matter). P001 follows as a mature, widely reproduced programme with a credit problem, P005 as a decisive observation with open attribution, and P002 is ranked low because the field is young and the mechanism unsettled.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; B024 is outside Kroll's own rare-earth quantum-memory work, though he works in nearby laser spectroscopy and precision optical coherence.
